command:
set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin --prune --quiet; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"; python3 -c "import base64,zlib;exec(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')))"; git diff --check; if grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.venv --exclude-dir=.pytest_cache --exclude='*.lock' '3\.12' projects/kobra2-neo; then echo 'stale 3.12 reference remains' >&2; exit 1; fi; test ! -e projects/kobra2-neo/docs/CHECKPOINT.md; test ! -e projects/kobra2-neo/docs/.gitkeep; cd projects/kobra2-neo; uv lock --check; uv sync --frozen; uv run python -m py_compile src/kobra_plot.py; uv run pytest -q; uv run kobra-plot doctor; rm -rf /tmp/kobra-closeout-curve /tmp/kobra-closeout-text; uv run kobra-plot prepare samples/svg/curve-demo.svg -o /tmp/kobra-closeout-curve; uv run kobra-plot text 'KOBRA CLOSEOUT' -o /tmp/kobra-closeout-text; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
for d in [Path('/tmp/kobra-closeout-curve'), Path('/tmp/kobra-closeout-text')]:
    report=json.loads((d/'report.json').read_text())
    assert report['safety']['valid'] is True
    assert report['execution']['allowed'] is False
    g=(d/'output.gcode').read_text()
    assert 'G0 Z2.97 F180' in g
    assert '3.12' not in g
    for bad in ('G28','G91','M104','M109','M140','M190',' E'):
        assert bad not in g
print('ARTIFACT_CHECK_OK')
PY
cd ../..; git status --short; git diff --stat; git diff --check; git add -A projects/kobra2-neo; git commit -m 'Finalize Kobra pen plotter baseline'; git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/chore/kobra-closeout-20260928
